notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
rdp* NSE scripts against port 3389 retrieve NetBIOS name, DNS name, Windows build number (product version), NLA/CredSSP requirement status, and domain/computer names via NTLM negotiation (rdp-ntlm-info) without completing auth.

=== MSTSHASH DETECTION ===
Nmap injects mstshash=nmap cookie into the RDP handshake — a known fingerprint detectable by EDR and threat hunters. In hardened environments this can result in the scanning host being blocked mid-assessment.

=== NLA CHECK ===
rdp-sec-check Perl script enumerates which security layers are supported (raw RDP, TLS, CredSSP/NLA). If only CredSSP required: pre-authentication credentials needed before any session-layer exploitation.
